description: This file defines a class Smarty_CacheResource_Mysql that implements a cache resource for Smarty templates using a MySQL database. It includes database connection setup, cache fetch, save, delete operations, and associated SQL queries.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Mysql
classes.description: A class implementing Smarty's cache resource using MySQL as storage, providing methods to fetch, save, delete cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MySQL connection and prepares SQL statements.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches cached content and modification time from the database based on a cache id.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Fetches the modification timestamp for a cache entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves cache content into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries from the database based on provided filters or truncates the entire cache.
